# Line Interpolation

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Interpolate GeoJSON lines with D3 curves or round corners with a physical turn radius.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/line-interpolation",
  "type": "LineInterpolationOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/line-interpolation').par.feature` (an input) and `op('/line-interpolation').out.feature` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.feature`, `out.feature`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `feature` | `GeoJsonField` | `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]}` |
| `method` | `StringLiteralField` | `"catmull-rom"` |
| `samplesPerSegment` | `NumberField` | `12` |
| `alpha` | `NumberField` | `0.5` |
| `tension` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `turnRadiusMeters` | `NumberField` | `250` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `feature` | `GeoJsonField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
